more_info.overview: Acetylated distarch glycerol is a historical modified-starch identity combining glycerol-related modification with acetylation. The JECFA record retains earlier evaluations and records withdrawn specifications. The designation therefore describes a historical preparation, with current manufacturing details and food-use conditions unconfirmed. Related modified starches have their own separate identities and evaluations.
more_info.banned_in:
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
